caption: The drawing depicts a classical-style statue of a female figure standing on a rectangular pedestal. The figure is draped in a long, flowing, white garment with folds outlined in grey and brown, extending from her shoulders to the ground. The woman is shown with her left arm outstretched and bent at the elbow, hand extended and fingers pointing forward, while her right arm is bent upward at the elbow, with her hand near her face. She has dark hair, styled and bound at the back, and wears a gold laurel wreath on her head and a gold bracelet on her right wrist. The skin of the figure is shaded pale blue-grey, contrasting with the gold jewelry and the white clothing. The entire figure is colored with muted tones on a plain, light beige background. There is a small signature or monogram in the lower right corner of the page.
title: Figurehead
